songtiScSourceResolution.fontNature: Apple system font, ships with macOS / iOS. PostScript names: STSongti-SC-Light / STSongti-SC-Regular / STSongti-SC-Black.

songtiScSourceResolution.recommendedPath: Run writer's Figma session on macOS. Songti SC is a system font; Figma desktop on macOS can load it via figma.loadFontAsync({ family: 'Songti SC', style: 'Regular' }) with no file copy and no licensing risk.
